name: fitness-coach
title_zh: 训练数据自己攒，剧情推进看成绩的 RPG 健身教练
tagline_zh: 健身最难的是坚持，不是动作。它用本地文件记录你的训练、疲劳和复训，再让训练结果推进剧情——练得好剧情才往前走。
tagline_en: Sticking with it is the hard part, not the movements. It keeps your sessions, fatigue and returns in local files, then lets the results move a storyline forward — train well and the plot advances.
desc_en: 本地文件驱动的长期健身教练与可选 RPG 成长系统。用于用户开始或记录训练、制定或调整计划、复盘训练、复训、报告疲劳疼痛、查询历史表现，以及推进由训练结果驱动的剧情时。
why_zh: 把「坚持」这个真问题用游戏机制解决，而不是再给一份训练计划表。全本地存档，数据不外传。
why_en: It answers the real problem — consistency — with a game mechanic instead of yet another training plan. Everything stays on your machine.
limit_zh: 数据全存本地 user-data/，换台机器就从零开始。没有 Python 环境时改由模型手写 JSON，脚本那层的单位和日期校验就失效了。
limit_en: All data lives in a local user-data/ folder; switch machines and you start over. Without Python it falls back to the model hand-writing JSON, losing the script's unit and date checks.
title_en: Fitness coach that levels you up by your real workout logs
